deadline.value: Computer Science takes fall applications by January 8.
deadline.quote: Fall – January 8th prior to Fall start.

gre_general.value: PhD applicants must take the GRE with at least 146 verbal, 151 quantitative and 3.0 analytical writing.
gre_general.quote: PhD applicants must have taken the Graduate Record Exam (GRE) and received minimum scores of 146 Verbal, 151 Quantitative, 3.0 Analytical Writing

also.quote: along with Graduate Record Examination (GRE) scores which should be at least 146 Verbal, 151 Quantitative, 3.0 Analytical Writing

supervisor.value: Students are assigned a faculty advisor on admission and choose a research advisor later.
supervisor.quote: Upon admission to the PhD program, the student will be assigned a faculty advisor who will remain their advisor until the student selects a research advisor.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's in computer science or a closely related field is accepted.
entry_route.quote: a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science (or a closely related field) from an accredited institution in the United States

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

funding.value: The pages fetched do not state a funding rule.

notes: The CS handbook (July 2025) is the department's PhD rule. GRE applies to all PhD applicants per handbook 2.2.
